name: Color Balance
description: Shifts the red, green and blue channels separately in the shadows, midtones and highlights.

params.name: rs
params.description: Shift of the red channel in the shadows (cyan to red)

params.name: rm
params.description: Shift of the red channel in the midtones (cyan to red)

params.name: rh
params.description: Shift of the red channel in the highlights (cyan to red)

params.name: gs
params.description: Shift of the green channel in the shadows (magenta to green)

params.name: gm
params.description: Shift of the green channel in the midtones (magenta to green)

params.name: gh
params.description: Shift of the green channel in the highlights (magenta to green)

params.name: bs
params.description: Shift of the blue channel in the shadows (yellow to blue)

params.name: bm
params.description: Shift of the blue channel in the midtones (yellow to blue)

params.name: bh
params.description: Shift of the blue channel in the highlights (yellow to blue)
